Class ShapeClipperConversion2D

Namespace
ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides Clipper/world-space conversion helpers for 2D paths, polygons, rectangles, points, and related enums.

public static class ShapeClipperConversion2D

Remarks

These helpers centralize conversion between ShapeEngine geometry types and Clipper2 types using the precision configured on ShapeClipper2D. Most methods write into caller-supplied destination collections and clear or resize them as needed.
